name: scaling_final_rmp_300_validation_v3
description: Non-formal one-run V3 Scaling validation isolating a 300-second final restricted-RMP recovery cap for the S50 High seed-0 DWCG-Pure CG12 instance.

output_settings.final_rmp_recovery_policy: best feasible restricted-RMP incumbent within a 300-second bounded final-RMP recovery budget when final RMP reaches TIME_LIMIT

post_run_decision_rule.case_a: If FinalRMP300 still accepts 153 flows and no acceptance improvement occurs after approximately 180 s, 180 s happened to be enough for this seed, but 300 s provides useful safety margin and becomes the preferred candidate cap.
post_run_decision_rule.case_b: If FinalRMP300 improves from 153 to 154+ flows between 180 and 300 s, 180 s was scientifically too aggressive and 300 s is justified.
post_run_decision_rule.case_c: If important acceptance improvements are still occurring close to 300 s, do not freeze 300 s yet and reconsider the final-RMP budget policy.
post_run_decision_rule.case_d: If 300 s reaches restricted-pool OPTIMAL substantially before the cap, 300 s is comfortably sufficient for this representative hard instance.
